result.topic_en: Bare calculations of two differential relations for quantities p and q (Riemann-invariant-like variables for air waves) involving dr, dt and a, together with sums of the form ΣX dx and their mixed differentials d and δ.
result.transcription:
$-dp + p'(dr - (2p+2q+1)\,a\,dt) + \frac{1}{2}\frac{a\,dt}{r} = 0 = \Sigma X\,dx$
$-dq + q'(dr - (2p+2q-1)\,a\,dt) + \frac{1}{2}\frac{a\,dt}{r} = 0 \quad \Sigma X'\,dx$
$d\Sigma X\,\delta x - \delta\Sigma X\,dx$
$d\Sigma X'\,\delta x - \delta\Sigma X'\,dx$
[-$-dp + \frac{1}{2}a\frac{dt}{r} = 0$-]
[-$-dq + \frac{1}{2}a\frac{dt}{r} = 0$-]
[-$dx$-]

methods.what: Differential relation for p along a characteristic direction, written as a Pfaffian form ΣX dx = 0
Analogous differential relation for q, written as a Pfaffian form ΣX' dx
Bilinear covariant (exterior derivative) of the Pfaffian forms, used to test integrability
Bilinear covariant of the second Pfaffian form
